title: The Tower
lesson: At 100x leverage, a 1% dip wipes you out. Trade small.
camera: starts close, pulls back as the tower grows; shake on the crash
sound: music bed (Curiosity, Diego Nava, Mixkit) cut hard at the collapse; thunks rising in pitch, whoosh, creak, crash, typewriter, low pad
fact_check: At 100x, a 1% adverse move equals 100% of margin (liquidation usually triggers slightly earlier because of maintenance margin).
